title: Sanger Tree of Life HMW DNA Extraction: Automated Plant MagAttract v.1
author: Edel Sheerin

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Buffer Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a lysis buffer master mix containing the following components:

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL Phosphate buffered saline (PBS)
Add 20 µL Proteinase K
Add 4 µL RNase A
Add 150 µL Buffer AL

steps.title: Prepare Samples and Heat Block
steps.instruction: Set a heat block to 50 °C and prepare tissue samples.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 50 mg of cryogenically homogenised tissue from each sample to 2 mL microcentrifuge tubes
Place tubes on dry ice to keep samples frozen

steps.title: Lysis and Homogenisation
steps.instruction: Add lysis buffer to samples and homogenise.

substeps.instruction: Add 374 µL of the lysis buffer master mix to each sample
Gently pipette 10 times with a wide-bore pipette tip to homogenise sample and mastermix

steps.title: Prepare KingFisher Plates
steps.instruction: Label nine 1 mL 96-well deep-well KingFisher™ plates and fill the required number of wells as follows:

substeps.instruction: Tip plate: 96-well tip comb (no reagent)
Elution 2: 200 µL Buffer AE
Elution 1: 200 µL Buffer AE
NFW Wash: 500 µL Nuclease-Free Water
PE Wash 2: 700 µL Buffer PE
PE Wash 1: 700 µL Buffer PE
MW1 Wash 2: 700 µL Buffer MW1
MW1 Wash 1: 700 µL Buffer MW1
Sample plate: 15 µL Suspension G magnetic beads and 280 µL Buffer MB

steps.title: Incubate Samples
steps.instruction: Incubate the samples to complete lysis.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge tubes briefly to collect contents
Incubate on the heat block at 50 °C for 2 hours
Remove tubes from heat block and centrifuge briefly to spin down

steps.title: Transfer Lysate to Sample Plate
steps.instruction: Transfer the lysate from sample tubes to the sample plate using a wide-bore pipette tip set to 380 µL, avoiding the transfer of large pieces of debris.

steps.title: Run KingFisher Apex Protocol
steps.instruction: Execute the automated extraction on the KingFisher™ Apex instrument.

substeps.instruction: Select the required protocol from the protocol list and press the play button
Load the filled plates onto the instrument following on-screen instructions
Remove the 'Tip Plate' when prompted prior to loading the 'Sample Plate'
Allow the protocol to run automatically (approximately 50 minutes)
Follow on-screen instructions to remove plates once completed

steps.title: Inspect and Clean Eluates
steps.instruction: Check elution plates for remaining magnetic beads.

substeps.instruction: If beads are present (common in viscous samples), transfer the sample to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube and place on a magnetic rack
Allow approximately 5 minutes for beads to migrate
Collect the clear DNA eluate using a wide-bore pipette tip

steps.title: Collect and Store DNA
steps.instruction: Transfer eluates to storage tubes and perform quality control.

substeps.instruction: Use a 200 µL multi-channel pipette with wide-bore tips to pipette eluates from the elution plate into microcentrifuge tubes
Pipette mix with wide-bore tips to fully homogenise DNA in the eluate
Perform required QC
Store DNA at 4 °C
